resources.string: Lets MK TV & Car Launcher open two apps side by side when you press Split on the car home screen, closes a split left behind after Home, and on the car home screen opens the launcher\'s Control Center instead of Android\'s notification shade. It uses the system split-screen, back and notification actions, checks whether the split-screen divider or the notification shade is shown, and notes which app is in front; it does not read what is on the screen.
